Cherry Gloss

Jelly crimson, wet finish

Finish
Jelly gloss
Shape
Almond · Medium
Wear
2–3 weeks
Price
kr 460

Five coats of translucent red, each one cured before the next. A solid red would take one. The difference is that light goes into this and comes back out, so the colour has a floor to it instead of sitting flat on the surface.

The top coat is the thickest we use on any set. It is also why this one photographs badly and looks best in person.

  • Ten hand-finished nails, plus two spares
  • Twelve sizes in the box — no fitting needed
  • Glue, adhesive tabs, a mini file and a cuticle stick
  • Reusable: soaked off gently, a set goes back on four or five times
